events.label: New Orleans ferry bombing kills 543
events.description: A terrorist bomb blows up a New Orleans ferry packed with sailors and their families - 543 dead, and ATF agent Doug Carlin is first on the scene.

events.label: Claire's body staged; died before blast
events.description: A woman's burned body washes up - Claire - and the forensics say she died hours before the bomb: she was killed, then used to plant it.

events.label: Snow White is a ~4.5-day wormhole window
events.description: A secret government lab shows Doug 'Snow White': a window on the past, four and a half days wide - they can watch everything that happened, but not touch it.

events.label: Surveillance courtship of Claire's last days
events.description: Doug watches Claire's last days through the window, following her lead on the bomber - and falls for the woman he knows is already dead.

events.label: Send note to past; Minuti finds it and is shot
events.description: Doug breaks the rules and sends a note into the past; the agent who receives it is shot dead within minutes - the past pushes back.

events.label: Present arrest of Oerstadt; case 'closed'
events.description: Working the case in the present, Doug's team arrests the bomber, Carroll Oerstadt - but 543 people are still dead and the case closes unsatisfying.

events.label: Carlin physically sent to morning of bombing
events.description: The lab goes further than watching: they send Doug himself through the wormhole, into the morning of the bombing.

events.label: Arrives past; stops Claire's murder
events.description: Doug arrives in time to save Claire from Oerstadt's murder - the first change to a past everyone believed was fixed.

events.label: Claire calls ATF — the call his office received
events.description: Claire phones in the tip about the ferry - and Doug realises the anonymous call his own office received days ago was always her.

events.label: Kills Oerstadt; drives bomb truck into river
events.description: Doug kills Oerstadt, handcuffs him to the bomb's truck, and drives it off the ferry onto the river road, clearing the deck of the dead man's plan.

events.label: Carlin drowns; Claire swims free
events.description: With the truck sinking, Doug drowns in the cab - the past takes its price - while Claire swims free.

events.label: Pier: surviving Claire meets present-timeline Doug
events.description: On the pier, grieving in one timeline, Doug meets Claire - alive, pulled from the river, in a world where the ferry never blew.

events.label: Branch where ferry is saved
events.description: The ending lands in the changed branch: the bombing undone, at the cost of the Doug who went back.

events.label: Ferry bombing investigation
events.description: The investigation into the ferry bombing, 543 victims deep.

events.label: Snow White surveillance past viewer
events.description: Following the evidence through Snow White's window on the past.

events.label: Send objects then self into past
events.description: First notes and objects cross into the past, then a living man.

events.label: Claire relationship
events.description: The relationship built through a window - Doug watching, then meeting her for real in the only place that matters.

events.label: Attempt to prevent bombing
events.description: The whole effort narrows to one aim: stop the bombing before it happens.

events.label: Ambush / death beats
events.description: The violent beats - the ambushes and deaths that the timeline exacts along the way.

events.label: Altered outcome; Carlin lives in new line
events.description: The altered outcome: in the branch where the ferry is saved, Carlin lives on in it.

events.label: Past writable with tech cost
events.description: The lab's lesson: the past can be written, but the technology - and history - exact a cost.

ruleEffects.effect: Physical leap forks a timeline where Claire lives and meets living Doug
Claire's ATF call was always in the investigation

outcome.summary: Dying Doug saves the ferry; living Doug meets surviving Claire on the pier in the healed branch.
